faq1_q: Q1: Is the NT$100,000 monthly rent tax-inclusive? Who pays the management fee, and is business registration allowed?
faq1_a: Yes—official business registration is ready! The NT$100,000/mo rent is tax-inclusive (rental tax covered by landlord), while the NT$8,050/mo community management fee is paid by the tenant. It holds a B-3 General Retail Occupancy Permit suitable for F&B, clinics, pharmacies, supermarkets, and offices.
faq2_q: Q2: How do we qualify for the 3-month rent-free fit-out period, and what is the deposit?
faq2_a: The security deposit is 2 months (NT$200,000). A 5-year lease includes a 3-month rent-free fit-out period (saving NT$300,000 in rent), giving your brand ample time for interior construction, licensing, and staff training.
faq3_q: Q3: Do you accept short-term pop-up stores or single-day events?
faq3_a: Yes! We welcome both 1–3 months short-term pop-up / seasonal sales and single-day events, exhibitions, or commercial shoots. Rates for short-term and daily rentals are custom quoted based on your schedule and event needs—please contact the owner via LINE or phone for a quote.
faq4_q: Q4: Do you collaborate with commercial real estate brokers and agents?
faq4_a: Yes! Direct tenants pay zero broker commission, and we warmly welcome real estate agents and commercial property brokers for co-brokering. Please contact Mr. / Mrs. Cheng via phone or LINE to arrange a viewing.
